mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate environment reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS increase above 0.5% signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and real consumption expenditures indicates robust aggregate demand, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict positive 20-day returns in >60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: In low-unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), labor market tightness triggers anticipated rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production signals robust economic output, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when INDPRO rises.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL increases indicate aggressive monetary tightening with high inflation, compressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint signal of rising FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL fails to predict negative 20-day returns in >60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: In strong industrial expansion regimes (INDPRO > 105.0), robust output supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when INDPRO > 105.0.
